instruction: split_name splits a full name into (first, last). Simplify it. Keep the name split_name.
hidden_invariant: Names are not always two words: 'Mary Jane Watson' must give ('Mary', 'Jane Watson') and 'Cher' must give ('Cher', ''). The tempting 'first, last = full.split(" ")' raises ValueError on 1 or 3+ words. (Harder task: the edge cases are NOT shown in any usage file -- it probes whether the model anticipates them unprompted.)
